title: Cross-process invitation decline/cancellation versus expiry races
priority: P1 — a 1v1 decline or TagDuel lobby cancellation racing the deadline sweeper must settle to one terminal state and release every physical-seat lock.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite database; player/deck fixtures are seeded locally and the parent connection is closed before worker processes start.
design.concurrency: Six races across independent Node processes and SQLite connections: three 1v1 decline-vs-expiry races and three TagDuel host-cancel-vs-expiry races.
design.clock: Action process sees deadline-1ms; expiry worker sees the exact deadline; an idempotent sweep retry reconciles transient SQLITE_BUSY.

assertions: each 1v1 invitation settles to declined or expired with exactly one terminal revision
each terminal 1v1 state has no duel_members or tag_members lock for either participant
each TagDuel lobby settles to cancelled or expired with exactly one terminal revision
each terminal TagDuel lobby has no tag_members or duel_members lock for any of its four physical seats
three previously accepted TagDuel seats remain recorded as accepted; no partial game state is created
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain byte-equivalent before and after all races
limitations: SQLite temporário e processos Node independentes; nenhum banco persistente é usado.
Verifica stores/transações reais; não usa gateway/guild Discord real.
Relógios determinísticos provam a fronteira de deadline, não a latência de produção.
Não integra nem certifica cartas e não altera comandos ou runtime.
